title: Large Language Models and Causal Inference in Collaboration: A Comprehensive Survey
paper_type_zh: 因果推断与大语言模型综述
best_for_zh: 关注因果推理、公平性、可解释性或因果发现的读者。
one_line: A Findings NAACL 2025 survey of two-way collaboration between causal inference and language models.
综述因果推断与大语言模型双向协作的研究。
why: It distinguishes using causal ideas to evaluate language models from using language models to assist causal tasks.
inclusion_reason: A peer-reviewed survey connecting causal reasoning, fairness, safety, explainability, and language models.

title: Problem
问题
html: Causal inference can improve predictive accuracy, fairness, robustness, and explainability by modeling causal relationships. This Findings NAACL 2025 survey asks how causal ideas can evaluate or improve language models, and how language models can assist causal tasks. It surveys both directions rather than releasing a new model or dataset.
因果推断通过刻画变量间因果关系，可能提升预测准确性、公平性、鲁棒性和可解释性。论文发表于 Findings NAACL 2025，考察因果观点如何评估或改进语言模型，以及语言模型如何辅助因果任务。它综述双向关系，而不发布新模型或数据集。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Its core idea is a two-way view: causal inference can be used to study LLM reasoning, fairness, safety, explainability, and multimodality; LLMs can support causal relationship discovery and causal effect estimation. This prevents readers from treating “causal LLM” as one undifferentiated claim. The useful first question is which direction of assistance a paper actually studies.
核心思想是双向视角：因果推断可用于研究语言模型的推理、公平性、安全性、可解释性和多模态能力；语言模型也可辅助因果关系发现和因果效应估计。这避免把“因果语言模型”当成单一含糊说法。首先应问清一篇论文研究的是哪一个方向。

title: Method
方法
html: This paper synthesizes existing research rather than specifying one training pipeline. Its inputs are causal frameworks and LLM studies; its output is a review of the two directions and their intersections. No common data release, reward, verifier, prompt format, or evaluation budget is asserted by the official abstract.
论文综合已有研究，而不是规定一个训练流程。输入是因果框架与语言模型研究；输出是两个方向及其交集的综述。官方摘要没有声称提供统一数据发布、奖励、验证器、提示格式或评测预算。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The evidence is the review's explicit coverage of reasoning, fairness, safety, explainability, multimodality, causal discovery, and effect estimation. It provides a map of claims and methods, not a single experiment that validates every connection. Individual causal assumptions and empirical measurements must be checked in the cited work.
论文的证据来自它对推理、公平性、安全性、可解释性、多模态、因果发现和效应估计的明确覆盖。它提供主张与方法的地图，而不是一项验证所有联系的单一实验。各项因果假设和实证测量仍需在被引用工作中检查。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The contribution is the collaborative framing of causal inference and LLMs from both perspectives. It does not make a new causal estimator or LLM the centerpiece; instead, it connects several application areas under explicit causal questions. That framing is valuable when distinguishing correlation-based performance from causal claims.
贡献在于从双方视角刻画因果推断与语言模型的协作。它不把新的因果估计器或模型作为核心，而是用明确的因果问题连接多个应用领域。当需要区分相关性表现与因果主张时，这种框架很有价值。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Causal conclusions depend on assumptions about variables and their relationships, and those assumptions can vary across applications. Results from causal discovery, effect estimation, model evaluation, and fairness analysis are therefore not automatically interchangeable. A survey can organize this diversity but cannot supply missing assumptions for each primary study.
因果结论依赖变量及其关系的假设，而不同应用的假设可能不同。因此，因果发现、效应估计、模型评估和公平性分析的结果不能自动互换。综述能整理这种多样性，却不能为每篇原始研究补足缺失假设。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this paper to decide whether a project needs causal evaluation of an LLM or LLM assistance for a causal task. It is especially useful for converting broad goals such as fairness or explainability into an explicit causal question. It should be paired with the relevant primary methods before drawing empirical conclusions.

Use the paper to write a short causal problem statement before choosing a method. Name the intervention or relationship of interest, the target quantity, the data available, the assumptions needed for interpretation, and the role the language model will play. This forces an important distinction between an LLM that is itself the object of causal evaluation and an LLM used as an assistant within a causal workflow. The two cases can use similar words while requiring different outputs and evidence. The survey helps identify appropriate primary studies, but it does not supply the assumptions or measurements needed to identify a particular effect in a new setting.

当项目需要对语言模型做因果评估，或需要语言模型辅助因果任务时，可用这篇论文厘清选择。它尤其能把公平性或可解释性等宽泛目标转化为明确的因果问题。在得出实证结论前，还应配合阅读相关原始方法。

选择方法前，可借本文写一段简短因果问题说明：列出关心的干预或关系、目标量、可用数据、解释所需假设，以及语言模型承担的角色。这迫使读者区分两种情况：语言模型本身是因果评估对象，或语言模型只是因果工作流中的助手。它们可使用相似词汇，却需要不同输出和证据。本文能帮助定位合适的原始研究，却不能为新场景提供识别特定效应所需的假设或测量。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Read the two directions separately and keep their outputs distinct: model evaluation or improvement on one side, causal discovery or effect estimation on the other. For each cited paper, record its causal question, assumptions, data, and measurement. This habit makes causal language more precise.

Add a short assumption sheet for every study. State the causal quantity or relationship under discussion, the data available, the role assigned to the language model, and what observation is used as evidence. Then ask whether the work uses causal ideas to assess or improve an LLM, or uses an LLM to assist a causal task; these directions can share vocabulary while producing different outputs. Do not turn a plausible explanation into a causal conclusion without the assumptions that justify it. Fairness, safety, and explainability may motivate causal analysis, but they do not make causal identification automatic. When comparing reported results, preserve the setting, data, and target quantity from the primary work. The survey is most useful for locating these distinctions and the relevant studies, not for supplying one shared estimator, dataset, or universal guarantee.

建议把两个方向分开阅读，并区分其输出：一边是模型评估或改进，另一边是因果发现或效应估计。对每篇被引用论文，记录其因果问题、假设、数据和测量方式。这一习惯能让因果表述更精确。

可为每项研究增加一张简短假设表：写下讨论的因果量或关系、可用数据、语言模型承担的角色，以及什么观察被用作证据。再问它是用因果思想评估或改进模型，还是用模型协助因果任务；两个方向可共享术语，却产生不同输出。没有支撑结论的假设时，不应把看似合理的解释写成因果结论。公平性、安全性和可解释性可以成为使用因果分析的动机，但并不自动带来因果识别。比较结果时，要保留原始研究的设置、数据和目标量。综述最适合帮助定位这些区别及相关研究，而不提供一套共享估计器、数据集或普适保证。

title: Citation
引用
html:
Xiaoyu Liu, Paiheng Xu, Junda Wu, Jiaxin Yuan, Yifan Yang, Yuhang Zhou, Fuxiao Liu, Tianrui Guan, Haoliang Wang, Tong Yu, Julian McAuley, Wei Ai, and Furong Huang. 2025. Large Language Models and Causal Inference in Collaboration: A Comprehensive Survey. Findings of NAACL 2025, pages 7683–7699. https://aclanthology.org/2025.findings-naacl.427/

The ACL Anthology record provides the citation and abstract. Use this overview first to decide which direction a question belongs to: causal methods used to evaluate or improve language models, or language models used to support causal work. The distinction matters because the desired output, evidence, and assumptions differ. For every cited result, retain the causal target, available data, and assumptions required for interpretation. A response that sounds causally plausible does not identify a causal effect, and an LLM-assisted workflow does not remove the need to state what the causal task requires. The survey connects this literature to fairness, safety, and explainability, but those motivations should not replace a stated causal question. Its role is to map two-way collaboration and point readers toward primary studies. Claims about a particular estimator, model behavior, dataset, or empirical result should be checked in those primary sources, where assumptions and measurement design are reported.

When using the card, write down what intervention or relationship is being considered and what observation could support the conclusion. This prevents a system's fluent explanation from being confused with evidence. It also makes clear why two studies with similar language may be answering different causal questions.

Xiaoyu Liu、Paiheng Xu、Junda Wu 等。2025。《Large Language Models and Causal Inference in Collaboration: A Comprehensive Survey》。Findings of NAACL 2025，7683–7699 页。https://aclanthology.org/2025.findings-naacl.427/

ACL Anthology 页面提供引文和摘要。可先判断问题属于哪一边：用因果方法评估或改进模型，还是用模型支持因果工作；二者所需输出、证据和假设不同。每个结果都应保留因果目标、可用数据和解释所需假设。看似合理的因果表述不能自行识别因果效应，模型辅助工作流也不能免除对任务要求的说明。综述关联公平性、安全性与可解释性，但这些动机不能替代明确因果问题。它绘制双向协作并指向原始研究；估计器、模型行为、数据集或实证结果的具体主张应回到原始来源查看其假设和测量设计。使用本卡时，可写下讨论的干预或关系，以及什么观察能支撑结论，从而避免把流畅解释混同为证据。
